correctness.rationale: Physical density operators commute with total parity and decompose into 2×2 even and odd blocks. Every normalized vector a|00>+b|11> or c|01>+d|10> is reached from a Gaussian Fock state by a determinant-one SU(2) matchgate parity block, hence is a pure Gaussian. Spectral decomposition establishes the complete convex-hull equality. Parity-preserving unitaries and parity-covariant two-qubit depolarization preserve physical states; SWAP commutes with parity. Substituting the paper’s η(SWAP)=1, p=0 into C_+(U,p)=max(0,η(1−p)(2−p)/2 +p²/8−p/2) gives 1, C_-=0. This refutes only the asserted local-preservation↔Choi condition, not a stronger complete/ancilla-safe definition.
